a: If you don't perform the processing specified for "by" in such an effect, the rest of the effect won't activate.
Card Q&A.q: If I don't trash 2 cards in my hand, can the part after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate?

Effect: [When Digivolving] By trashing 2 cards in your hand, unsuspend this Digimon. Then, if [WereGarurumon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may return 1 Digimon card with [Garurumon] or [X Antibody] in its name from your trash to the hand.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Garurumon] or [Omnimon] in its name, by trashing 1 card in your hand, unsuspend this Digimon.
